_meta.description: LinkedIn programmatic refresh-token exchange for approved partners. POST to the accessToken endpoint with a form-encoded refresh_token grant and client credentials in the FORM BODY (client_id + client_secret, NOT Basic). Returns a new access_token, expires_in, and a refresh_token. Doc-derived; tokens are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/shared/authentication/programmatic-refresh-tokens (POST /oauth/v2/accessToken, grant_type=refresh_token, refresh_token, client_id, client_secret in form body; response access_token/expires_in/refresh_token/refresh_token_expires_in/scope)
